item.title: Adapt & Drive: Buying An Adapted Car In The UK
item.description: Accessible motoring in the UK is changing. While established schemes have helped thousands of disabled motorists regain independence, many people still fall outside traditional routes to adapted car ownership. That’s the gap Mobility in Motion aims to bridge with its new Adapt & Drive scheme — a collaborative initiative with leading car manufacturers including Kia, Nissan and Vauxhall. item.title: Petrol Vs Electric Motability Cars: Which Should You Choose?
item.description: If you have spent any time looking at a new Motability car recently, you have probably noticed just how many electric vehicles (EVs) are now available on the Scheme. And with that comes the big question. Should you go electric, or stick with petrol?

item.title: Nissan Micra Electric Motability Review | Nissan Micra EV Road Test
item.description: Nissan’s Micra has gone electric, borrowing heavily from Renault in the process. Aimed at the style-conscious end of the small EV class, it’s a radical shift for the nameplate, and for Nissan’s approach to small cars.

item.title: BYD Sealion 5 Motability Review | BYD Sealion 5 DM-i Road Test
item.description: BYD expands its foothold in the mid-size plug-in hybrid SUV market with the Sealion 5 DM-i, a well-equipped yet potentially more affordable option that gives you what you need, without the inflated price.

item.title: Motability And Nissan Partner On V2G Technology To Cut EV Costs
item.description: Motability Operations and Nissan have announced a strategic partnership to explore how Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology could help reduce electricity costs for electric vehicle (EV) drivers.

item.title: Motability Drive Smart Now Mandatory For First-Time Customers From April 2026
item.description: The Motability Scheme has announced a significant update to its Drive Smart initiative, expanding who must take part from April 2026.

item.title: Motability Scheme Changes 2026: What It Really Means For Drivers
item.description: Motability has confirmed a series of significant changes to the Scheme from 1 July 2026, following government tax changes announced in November 2025 and rising costs. Below, we answer the key questions customers are asking and explain what the changes are likely to mean in practice.

item.title: Toyota bZ4X Motability Review | Toyota bZ4X Electric Road Test
item.description: The bZ4X, Toyota’s mid-size electric SUV, has been significantly improved with a refreshed exterior, a revised cabin and powertrain, and technical updates that boost performance, extend range and speed up charging.

item.title: Wheelchair Offer Removed From Motability Scheme Benefits
item.description: Customers are no longer able to add a lightweight manual wheelchair to their order when placing a new Motability Scheme application.
